<b>Rosary Necklaces</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Can be used from the inventory to gain {{R|120}}.

Strung Rosaries are not dropped upon death.

== How to Acquire ==
Rosary Necklaces can be purchased for {{R|140}} from [[Frey]], who has an unlimited supply.

They may also be found by interacting with glowing item spots across [[Pharloom]], and as a reward for completing [[Wishes]].

==Trivia==
* Rosary Necklaces were likely originally valued at {{R|100}}; <i>EDGE Magazine</i> mentions a {{R|100}}-worth item that is sold by [[Pebb]];<ref name="edge55">[https://pocketmags.com/us/edge-magazine/february-2021 Edge Magazine February 2021 Edition] p. 55.</ref> none currently exists, but as the [[Rosary String]]'s value is known to have increased by {{R|20}} throughout development, it is likely that the Rosary Necklace's did as well. Additionally, Necklaces are not sold by Pebb currently, which they seem to have been previously.
